displayDescription: A skeuomorphic patch panel: a spark switch powers on, five cables patch the idea into a working system, and the marquee confirms it's online.
audioDescription: Silent: no music, voice or sound effects.
limitations: Materials are procedural approximations. Brushed metal and walnut grain are seeded Canvas 2D textures prerendered once, and lighting uses SVG gradients and drop-shadows rather than physical rendering.
The toggle flip is a front-view scaleY foreshortening, not true 3D rotation.
Neither Blender nor Three.js was used, as instructed. The scene doesn't need real 3D depth.
STYLE.json has no preview_recipes, so no recipe is demonstrated. The refresh covers the scene-dependent background and the source-review construction lessons.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent. The host runs QA.
